code.heading: Who We Are
code.intro:
We are THE ORDER. We are the antithesis of hedonism. In a world of fading values, we remain steadfast as righteous men of heart, soul, mind and strength. We are the Order of men who uphold the old ways of chivalry and nobility -- ways that have been lost, buried, and actively destroyed. We are gentlemen, we are fathers, husbands, brothers, lovers, men of God. But we are also savages -- ruthlessly capable of defending one another, and those it is our duty to protect.

We are men of Truth, Action and Virtue; an ageless Brotherhood.

become.heading: We're Offering You Your Body Back
become.offerings:
Physical Resilience -- the strongest, toughest, most athletic and healthiest version of you, built to last decades
Discipline -- train, eat and sleep like a man with a mission, held accountable daily
Savagery -- a call to your nature; to be wild, physically capable and primal; again
Warrior Code -- strength in service of something; a protector's body, not a vanity project
Mental Fortitude -- the calm, centred, focussed mind that only a hard-trained body carries
Brotherhood -- train, suffer and celebrate beside like minded, integrous savage gentlemen
Adventure -- survival, combatives and wild country retreats that demand the body you are building
Courage -- the strength to answer your calls-to-action and conquer your fears
Purpose -- a reason to be strong that outlasts motivation
Transcendence -- find the truest and realest you; the body is the doorway
Love -- the energy and presence to show up fully for your girl, your family, and those you love
become.closing: I hope you join us at your strongest

faq.heading: Questions a Serious Man Asks
faq.questions:
Do you wish not only to get fit, but to transform and prosper in every arena?
Are you tired of programs that train the body and abandon the man?
Are you capable, humble and courageous enough to pass an eight-week program?
Do you want to stand in a global brotherhood of strong, disciplined, savage gentlemen?
Do you want to attend daring, physical, life-changing retreats and bond with high calibre brethren?
Do you want to be held accountable daily, in training, eating, sleeping and recovering, toward lasting transformation?
Do you want to inhabit the strongest, healthiest, most capable version of yourself, released from the shackles of comfort?

howWeOperate.heading: How We Operate & What to Expect
paragraphs: We meet virtually (online) -- except for in-person retreats.

AND YOU START HERE: Each man conducts his initial Rite-of-Passage, an eight-week program, alongside other prospecting brethren, dubbed "The Program." This is your entire initial focus and pathway to The Order: learning to become your own mentor, your own sovereign commander; to push through limiting beliefs and courageously charge through any and all fear holding you back; to meet the real you, the "youest you," the man you were always destined to be -- you know him. Ultimately, to forge each man as his most glorious version, worthy of like-minded, self determined and prosperous brothers. I hope you meet him.
At the end of  The Program, if it is a "fuck yes" from you and a "fuck yes" from us, you will be invited into the brotherhood.

You are now an alumnus of  THE ORDER -- but this is where the real work begins. Thereafter, we meet once a week, ongoing, to forge real, true and lasting transformation, directed by you, in your own order of necessity.
You are not alone. The other half of  THE ORDER is the power of your brotherhood -- the men beside you, holding one another accountable, daily, in community.

Retreats are held every two to four months, varying in activity so you can choose the one/s that best serve your prosperity and needs. One retreat per year must be attended, unless you are financially limited. Retreats include survival, indigenous medicine, combative, adventure, celebration, leisure, etc.

After one to two years as an alumnus -- once you have shown commitment, dedication and awareness -- you will be "accoutred" by THE ORDER. I hope to see each of you there because I will be your biggest advocate.
howWeOperate.pullQuote: If it's not a fuck yes, it's a no.

founder.heading: Who Am I
paragraphs: I am a former SAS tier-1 (Special Operations) Operator with three kill/capture combat deployments and thirteen years in the military; I have overcome and thrived through PTSD and autoimmunity post war; I am a Master Freemason and a Knight of the Order of Saint Martino, Rome; I am a Founder, an artist, a lover, a gentleman, a savage, and a man of God.

I watched, patiently, waiting for an organisation, a leader, someone or something to come forth and restore the Order - to bring us back to the old ways, to be masculine and righteous again. And it has not come, yet.
"Be the change you wish to see in the world." - Mahatma Gandhi
So I became what I wished to see in this world; and I ask you to come with us.

verses.text: Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind and with all your strength.
